grammar_focus: KS18+KS42 使役结构 have sth done(请/让别人做某事:have + 物 + 过去分词;had the plane packaged / have my car washed / have the plane restored)(教材 L66 Key structures)主考;SD 集合名词主谓一致——美语里 team/group/audience/crew 等作整体用单数(is/was/has)(辅考,美语规则,不出英式复数陷阱)
scene: 1963年,一架老式飞机坠落在南太平洋一个偏僻的小岛上,远离任何地方。飞机损坏不严重,但多年后被人遗忘,残骸静静躺着无人问津。后来在1989年,一次对小岛的航拍勘测中它被重新发现了。那时,一架状态这么好的飞机已经很稀有,值得抢救。法国当局请人把飞机打包,分件运回了法国。如今一群爱好者打算请人把飞机修复。它有四个引擎,但这群人只需请人修复其中三个。想象一下他们打开包装箱时有多惊讶——第四个引擎“像蜜一样甜”,依然完好无损。一群蜜蜂把这个引擎变成了蜂房,它被蜂蜡完完全全地封存了起来!

grammar_card.title: 使役结构 have sth done
grammar_card.intro: KS18+KS42 have + 物 + 过去分词 = 请/让别人做某事(自己不亲自做,而是请人代劳,或遭遇某事)。对比:I washed my car(自己洗)vs I had my car washed(请人洗)。常见生活场景:have my hair cut(理发)、have my watch repaired(修表)、have the plane restored(请人修复飞机)。否定/疑问借助 do:Did you have it repaired? / I didn't have it repaired。

specialRules.rule: 否定与疑问用 do/did 助动:Did you have your watch repaired? / I didn't have my watch repaired。各种时态皆可:will have to have it repaired、are going to have it restored、need to have it rebuilt。
📌 美语规则:team/group/audience/crew/government/staff 等集合名词通常当作一个整体、用单数动词(is/was/has);英式英语有时用复数(are/were),但本美语课程一律以单数为准。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What was 'sweet as honey' and why?
options: The fourth engine — a colony of bees had turned it into a hive and preserved it in beeswax
A jar of real honey found on the plane

passage: In 1963, an old airplane came down on a remote island in the South Pacific, a long way from anywhere. The plane wasn't badly damaged, but over the years it was forgotten, and the wreck lay undisturbed. Then in 1989, it was rediscovered during an aerial survey of the island. By then, a plane in such condition was rare and worth rescuing. The French authorities had the plane packaged and moved back to France in parts. Now a group of enthusiasts is going to have the plane restored. It has four engines, but the group only needs to have three of them rebuilt. Imagine their surprise when they broke open the packing cases! The fourth engine was sweet as honey — still in perfect condition. A colony of bees had turned the engine into a hive, and it was completely preserved in beeswax!
